title: Wildlife Protection Act 1972
content: The Wildlife Protection Act is a foundational policy framework for conserving wildlife, regulating hunting, and protecting habitats. It establishes protected areas, legal safeguards for endangered species, and enforcement mechanisms for illegal trade.
